title: langchain-milvus 0.4.0 introduces unresolvable pymilvus>=3.0.0 dependency
error_summary: Fromager cannot resolve pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 (required by langchain-milvus 0.4.0): blocked by release-age cooldown on x86_64, no sdist available on aarch64
suggested_resolution_summary: Constrain langchain-milvus<0.4 in requirements to stay on pymilvus 2.x series
confidence_justification: Error messages directly name the failing dependency (pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0) and the resolution mechanism (release-age cooldown on x86_64, no sdist on aarch64). PyPI metadata confirms langchain-milvus 0.4.0 introduced the pymilvus>=3.0.0 requirement (0.3.3 used pymilvus<3.0,>=2.6.0). pymilvus 3.0.0 is confirmed as wheel-only with no sdist. The error chain from langchain-milvus → pymilvus is directly visible in trace logs across both x86_64 and aarch64 jobs.
target_repo_reason: The fix requires adding a version constraint to langchain-milvus in the requirements files under collections/rhai/*/requirements/team-notebooks-images.txt, which are in the pipeline repository.
